title_en: The Greatest Messenger (peace be upon him and his family) in Umayyad Heritage and Islamic Heritage (Episode 26)
summary: Part of the Debates in Creed series, this lecture by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari analyzes how the Prophet Muhammad is depicted in Umayyad versus general Islamic sources.
series_en: Debates in Creed - The Greatest Messenger in Islamic Heritage
